messages.author: 3d9ae76d08a196e1
messages.subject: Drawing a gList object
parts:
Hi all,

I am using the package "VennDiagram" but cannot figure out a way to print the produced plot into my knitr report.

library(VennDiagram)
g2 <- draw.pairwise.venn(5, 3, 2)
class(g2)
## [1] "gList"


This one produced a plot in my RStudio plotting window:

grid.draw(g2)

Using grid.draw(g2) to print to a file also works. But when grid.draw(g2) is in my .Rnw file, nothing happens.

Any suggestions?

Many thanks!
